# Career Navig8r

> A mentoring platform connecting experienced professionals with mentees seeking career guidance, development, and flexible income opportunities.

Career Navig8r is a mentorship marketplace that enables professionals to find mentors across various sectors and allows experienced professionals to earn income by mentoring others. The platform supports both structured mentorship relationships and flexible side income opportunities for mentors.

## Key Topics

- Mentorship platform
- Career guidance
- Mentor matching
- Professional development
- Career development
- Mentor signup
- Side hustle
- Flexible mentoring
- Navig8r Profile
- Navigator program
- Mentee onboarding
- Professional growth
- Career mentorship
- Platform community
- Mentoring services
